cases.context:
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ENNReal
definition_context: gaussianReal a v is the actual Borel Gaussian measure on the real line with mean a and variance v.
The two local let expressions are sums of nonnegative scalar multiples of measures.
wassersteinDistance is the square root of the infimum of integrated squared norm displacement over couplings with the two given marginals.
ENNReal.ofReal embeds a nonnegative real in the extended nonnegative reals.
cases.statement:
example (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    let μ := (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal (-m) 1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal m 1
    let ν := (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal (-m) 1 + (3 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) • gaussianReal m 1
    ENNReal.ofReal (m / 2) ≤ WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ ν ∧
      WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal m
